title: Sacred Art Up to 250 Years Old Coming to Nuevo Laredo’s Museo Reyes Meza
excerpt: A free exhibit of 50 to 60 pieces of sacred art, some up to 250 years old, opens Thursday, Dec. 3, at the Museo Reyes Meza in Nuevo Laredo’s Centro Cultural and runs about three months.
content:
A collection of 50 to 60 pieces of sacred art, some up to 250 years old, will go on display starting Thursday, Dec. 3, at the Museo Reyes Meza in Nuevo Laredo’s Centro Cultural, according to CML Noticias.

The free exhibit, organized by the municipal government led by Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal in coordination with the Diocese of Nuevo Laredo, will bring together paintings, sculptures, religious images, photographs, liturgical vestments, chalices and other sacred objects from communities across Tamaulipas and Nuevo León, including Nuevo Laredo, Villaldama, Lampazos, Ciudad Mier, Sabinas Hidalgo and Vallecillo.

Visitors will be able to see works in late Baroque, neoclassical and contemporary styles, reflecting the history and religious traditions of the region, according to Father José Salvador Rojas Sainz, the Diocese’s delegate for the exhibit.

“Es la primera vez que se lleva a cabo una exposición así, de la mano con la Diócesis de Nuevo Laredo”, said Felipe Flores Montemayor, the city’s director of Art and Culture, noting that museum staff are preparing the galleries, installing protective display cases and arranging the spaces for the collection.

Education, Culture and Sport Secretary Javier Acebo Garza said the exhibit will bring pieces that are normally kept inside their communities’ churches closer to the public, and that it is also a chance for people from other communities in Tamaulipas and Nuevo León to learn about the region’s heritage.

The exhibit opens Thursday, Dec. 3, at 5 p.m. at the Museo Reyes Meza, in the Centro Cultural de Nuevo Laredo. It will remain open about three months and can be visited Tuesday through Sunday, from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m., with free admission. The city invited families, students and the general public to attend, regardless of their religious beliefs.

Sources: CML Noticias — “Exhibirán en Nuevo Laredo arte sacro con piezas históricas de hasta 250 años de antigüedad”, https://www.cmlnoticias.com/2026/11/23/exhibiran-en-nuevo-laredo-arte-sacro-con-piezas-historicas-de-hasta-250-anos-de-antiguedad/
